put.description:
Sets cost limits (null = unlimited). Exceeding the project limit pauses the
project (circuit breaker); resuming needs a higher limit (ADR-0006).

get.description: Timeline / replay. Filters narrow the result; paging stays by sequence.

post.description:
Adds an agent to the project. Adding an orchestrator replaces the active one
(new assignment version; BR-01).

The artifact's bytes, only if the file still matches the recorded checksum
and lies inside this project's workspace (BR-04).

Pause/resume/cancel/redirect a task or the whole project (§8.3).

``status`` stays ``requested`` until the runtime observes the effect; watch
for ``intervention.applied`` (BR-06, AC-06).

Approve or reject a pending approval (BR-07). Only project owners decide;
an expired or already decided approval cannot be changed (409).
